Subject: SIG intake request — initial mapping and timeline

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for agreeing to support Riverside's vendor SIG review. We received the SIG questionnaire from our procurement team and are doing an initial intake for ownership and evidence timelines. Our deadline to receive completed SIG items is July 16, but procurement asked for an internal delivery plan by July 9 so they can lock external deadlines.

Can you do a quick owner mapping for each SIG section (who on your team will provide answers and attachments) and a two-week evidence delivery schedule? We mainly need: access control, change mgmt, vendor mgmt, encryption/key mgmt, incident response, and network architecture.

Also: please indicate any items that require SOC 2 artifacts (policies, test evidence, SOC report excerpts) — we may queue a follow-up SOC2 evidence request.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful; our team is available Thu/Fri this week.

Thanks,
Samira Patel
Director, Vendor Risk
Riverside Health
security@riversidehealth.com

- Section: Access Control (AuthN/AuthZ, MFA, account lifecycle) — Owner: Mina Haddad — deliver by 2026-07-06
- Section: Change Management & CI/CD Controls — Owner: Dev Patel — deliver by 2026-07-07
- Section: Vendor / Third-party Management — Owner: Marissa Cole — deliver by 2026-07-06
- Section: Data Encryption & Key Management — Owner: Mina Haddad (assist: Dev) — deliver by 2026-07-08
- Section: Incident Response & Notification — Owner: Marissa Cole — deliver by 2026-07-07
- Section: Network Architecture & Segmentation — Owner: Dev Patel — deliver by 2026-07-09

Flagged items that likely require SOC2 artifacts: access control policy reviews, change control test traces, and incident response test evidence. If we need SOC2 excerpts we should note that in the tracker and prepare a separate delivery slot (Riverside indicated possible follow-up).

Action items:
1) Reply with confirmations/changes to the owner mapping above.
2) Populate the tracker with file pointers and expected attachment names (I created a starter tracker and shared Drive link below once team confirms).
